text:
jen: Heads-up — draft of release notes for the upcoming docs push is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1347. Need quick sweep for clarity, missing SDK snippets, and known-issue blurb. Can folks triage? :eyes:
ben: On it. I'll sanity-check API examples and flags. Any specific targets for snippet languages? python + go by default?
maya: Python + go + node please. Main pain is the embeddings streaming deprecation note and the new batching guidance.
oliver: Linked PR looks good. Found two broken anchor links under /guides/migrations — I'll send a small patch. also: we should call out the routing fallback behavior under 'Known issues'
ben: Good catch. @oliver please drop the commit link when ready. Also, what about the SDK snippet that shows `client.generate`? That's old.
oliver: Added a commit with fixed anchors: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/abc123. Also note: embedding payload example needs to show `streaming=false` for compatibility.
ben: SDK lead ping: @sdk-lead — can you review the snippet correctness? current Python sample uses old client API v0.9.
sdk-lead: Thanks — I'll PR a snippet upgrade today. For Python, replace `client.generate` -> `client.text.generate` and reformat options. Will post diff.
docs-bot: Automated linkcheck: 2 failures in /whats-new/ — failing anchors reported. See CI: https://ci.redwood/links/98765
jen: Thanks. For the "what's new" blurb, please keep it to 2 bullets max and add a 'Known issues' section with one-liner items. I'll draft the bullets if someone approves the wording.
maya: Approve — keep the first bullet about smarter batching, second about private deploy beta. For known issues: mention cache invalidation edge case with dedicated pools.
ben: Quick note on changelog formatting: use hyphen bullets, and version header `v0.12.1 (2026-04-03)` — I'll update dates.
sdk-lead: PR for snippet updates: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1349 — includes py/go/node examples and a small test harness.
jen: Perfect. Last call: anyone want to flag additional regressions? otherwise I'll merge and tag tomorrow AM. :rocket:
oliver: One more: add migration note about `kv_cache` name change -> `cache.kv` in runtime config.
maya: I'll add that line under migration guide, sending patch in 30m.
ben: Merged changelog formatting commit. Tag me if QA finds anything.
